blocks.text: Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez displayed her signature showmanship at the much-awaited swimsuit competition of the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant in Thailand on Tuesday morning, Sept. 29. The international pageant brought the fan-favorite event back to the roofdeck of Lebua State Tower in Bangkok, the same venue where the Philippines’ Samantha Bernardo showcased her now iconic pasarela routine at the 2020 competition. Wearing regulation swimsuit, a yellow, two-piece, string bikini, Lopez masterfully navigated the whole stretch of the makeshift runway, and descended down the long flight of stairs leading to a round platform at the landing.
